title: Case 008: Certificate for the property owner
initial_request: Hello Lara, I understand that my policy for 108 Hazel Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 8ZZ is in place, but I cannot find the certificate in your file. Could you please send me a copy?
overview: Adam Vale asked his broker, Lara at Wrenbrook Brokers, for the certificate for his insured property. Lara confirmed it was not in the broker's file and requested it from Northmere General Insurance using policy reference INS-008. The insurer sent the certificate to Lara, who forwarded it to Adam; Adam confirmed that he received it.

next_action.summary: At the escalation point, request the certificate directly from Northmere General Insurance using policy reference INS-008.

outcome: The certificate received from Northmere General Insurance was sent to Adam, who confirmed receipt.

events.body: Hello Lara, I understand that my policy for 108 Hazel Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 8ZZ is in place, but I cannot find the certificate in your file. Could you please send me a copy?
The policy is recorded as in place, but there is no certificate in our file. I will request the document from Northmere General Insurance using reference INS-008.
Please send the insurance certificate for Adam Vale's policy, reference INS-008, covering 108 Hazel Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 8ZZ. We do not have a copy in our file.

We have issued certificate CERT-008 for Adam Vale under policy INS-008, for 108 Hazel Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 8ZZ. It states the period 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026; insurance-certificate.png is attached and may be forwarded to him.

Northmere General Insurance has sent us the certificate for your policy. I am forwarding insurance-certificate.png (CERT-008) for 108 Hazel Walk, Brackenford, ZZ1 8ZZ, which states the period 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2026.
Thanks, I have received insurance-certificate.png. That is the certificate I was looking for.
